# Third-Party Assets

## Kenney Nature Kit

- Source: https://kenney.nl/assets/nature-kit
- Creator: Kenney
- License: Creative Commons Zero (CC0 1.0)
- Included license: `kenney_nature/License.txt`

The models may be used, modified, and redistributed in personal and commercial
projects. Attribution is not required, but the source is retained here for
project provenance.

## Kenney Blocky Characters

- Source: https://kenney.nl/assets/blocky-characters
- Creator: Kenney
- License: Creative Commons Zero (CC0 1.0)
- Included license: `kenney_characters/License.txt`

The player and NPC visual models use the included rigged GLB assets. Emberfall's
existing gameplay scripts, collision bodies, dialogue, shops, and quest data
remain separate from the imported visual scenes.

## Kenney Fantasy Town Kit

- Source: https://kenney.nl/assets/fantasy-town-kit
- Creator: Kenney
- License: Creative Commons Zero (CC0 1.0)
- Included license: `kenney_fantasy_town/License.txt`

The interactive single and double doors use the arched wooden door leaf from
the included GLB assets.

## Emberfall Monster Models

- Sources: Quaternius animated animal, animated character, and Cube World kits
- License: Creative Commons Zero (CC0 1.0)
- Included license details: `emberfall_monsters/LICENSES.md`

These GLB models replace the custom wolf, goblin, and boar visuals while the
existing Emberfall collision and gameplay nodes remain authoritative.
